'''Operations officer''' was a section chief and command crew position aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and was responsible for heading the Operations section aboard the vessel. The Operations Officer oversaw the running of the ship with several other sections reporting in to the section chief. Both the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]<ref name="FOP" /> and the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]]<ref name="TDC" /> used Operations Officers aboard their ships. For the Imperial Navy, the Operations Officer was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of at least junior [[Commander/Legends|commander]] rank.<ref name="FOP" /> They were responsible for communications, navigation and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] operations. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Darryn Thyte]] served as the Operations Officer aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during its mission to locate the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="TDC" />
